name: Apothecary Lydon
summary: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon studies poisons for the Royal Apothecary Society. Bored and sunk in gloom, he takes pleasure in lethal brews and the suffering they cause. His research seeks to secure Hillsbrad for the Forsaken and advance Sylvanas's New Plague.

sections.title: The Recluse of Tarren Mill
sections.body: Inside Tarren Mill's chapel, now a laboratory, Apothecary Lydon carries out the cold work of the Royal Apothecary Society. Flowers in bloom and Hillsbrad Foothills' crisp air only deepen his languid melancholy. Deathcraft is the one diversion that lifts his gloom. Left alone, he poisons, dissects, and reanimates his pet frog, Umpi, again and again while he waits for new reagents.

sections.title: Concoctions of Agony
sections.body: With Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity, Lydon runs field experiments across Hillsbrad. His work advances from the Elixir of Suffering to the virulent Elixir of Agony. He sends adventurers to test the brews on local wildlife, domesticated animals, and captured human farmers. His loyalty belongs wholly to the Dark Lady, and he longs for their finished New Plague to cleanse the living world.

sections.title: Venom of the Loa
sections.body: Lydon's studies also reach into esoteric poisons. When mysterious venom bottles appear in the region, he asks troll mystics such as Master Gadrin to trace their origin. The trail leads to the spider goddess Shadra in the Hinterlands. Once gathered, the primeval venom goes to the Apothecarium in the Undercity to advance the Forsaken plague effort.

faq.answer: From Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills, Lydon works as an alchemist of the Royal Apothecary Society. He oversees experimental plagues and toxins for Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

Lydon is sunk in melancholy and finds Hillsbrad's natural beauty and fresh air repulsive. Cruel experiments, the suffering of the living, and the scent of alchemical embalming fluids are the only things that lift his spirits.
Umpi is the frog Lydon keeps in his workshop and wryly calls his assistant. To relieve his boredom, he repeatedly poisons, kills, and reanimates her.

faq.q: What is the Elixir of Agony?
faq.answer: The Elixir of Agony is an experimental poison Lydon brews from Mudsnout Blossoms, then refines with Master Apothecary Faranell's colloid of decay. He activates it with a strong troll's blood potion, daggerspine scales, and torn fin eyes, then laces a keg of stout stolen from the dwarves of Dun Garok and tests it on captive farmers in Hillsbrad.
No record tells how Lydon died or rose. Like the other Forsaken, he broke free of the Lich King's control under Sylvanas and now devotes his undead existence to the Dark Lady and her New Plague.

faq.q: What does Lydon send to the Undercity?
faq.answer: After finding ancient venom vessels in the Hinterlands and helping bring about the downfall of the troll spider god Shadra, Lydon gathers her concentrated, divine venom. He sends it directly to Master Apothecary Faranell to strengthen the Society's plague research.

angles.text: As an undead, Lydon embodies the Royal Apothecary Society's mission: develop the New Plague to secure a future for the Forsaken and eradicate the living.
To the humans of Southshore, Lydon is a horror who brews lethal diseases and tests them without distinction on captive Hillsbrad farmers and wildlife.
Lydon's workshop holds reagents, cauldrons, and rotting flora, showing how the Apothecary Society turns traditional gathering arts toward its work.
